blurb: All About Dance provides dance education and experiences for all ages, including parent-and-child classes for ages 0-3, recreational dance classes, birthday parties, and studio rentals. They emphasize a welcoming, inclusive environment and offer various dance styles and programs. The studio hosts events and competitions, with dancers recognized for excellence.
extraNote: Free trials offered for new students · Up to 3 make-up classes per class per session for recreational dancers · Make-up classes do not roll over between sessions · No make-up classes during final two weeks of Fall & Winter/Spring sessions
